name: Anup Chathoth
headline: Product/ business leader and former CEO with P&L ownership. Currently building and scaling new Network-as-a-Service and platform businesses at T-Mobile. Experience spanning product, GTM, pricing, and zero-to-one growth.
summary: General Manager and former startup CEO with a track record of building and scaling new businesses across startups and large enterprises. Owned end-to-end outcomes spanning product, go-to-market, pricing, and P&L.

positions.title: Director of Products, Network as a Service Products and Platforms
positions.description:
Owner for Network-as-a-Service and Network API products and platform, accountable for products, commercialization, and scale.

Own product, GTM, pricing, and platform strategy to enable partner adoption and revenue growth across identity, authentication, fraud, and communications offerings.

Build and lead cross-functional teams across product, engineering, and operations to take zero-to-one initiatives into scalable, revenue-generating businesses.

Work directly with customers and partners to validate demand, shape customer experience, and drive adoption and expansion.

Partner with senior leadership for investment decisions, operating model, growth strategy, and execution cadence.

positions.title: Corporate Strategy and Strategic Initiatives
positions.description:
Founding member of a centralized Strategy & Ops team responsible for setting and driving annual corporate strategic priorities and early-stage growth initiatives.

Partnered directly with senior leadership to define, prioritize, and sequence the portfolio of growth bets, including major 5G-related programs.

Worked with business, technology, and product leaders to translate strategy into multi-year roadmaps with clear execution milestones and dependencies.

Partnered with FP&A on capital allocation decisions, investment scale, and growth trajectory for priority initiatives.

Owned the operating cadence and decision forums to drive alignment, tradeoffs, and execution across executive stakeholders.

positions.title: Co-founder and CEO
positions.description:
Founded and scaled a global hardware–software company, serving 5,000+ B2B customers and leading OEM/ODM partners across 140+ countries.

Owned full P&L and company strategy, including product, GTM, pricing, partnerships, and operations from inception through scale.

Built and led cross-functional teams across the US and China spanning engineering, product, design, and operations.

Established and managed the global supply chain, OEM ecosystem, and factory operations in China to support scalable production and margin discipline.

Served as chief product owner, overseeing architecture and delivery of all hardware and software platforms.

Selected by Microsoft for its Kinect accelerator as one of the most innovative companies in the ecosystem; acted as external evangelist through Microsoft and industry channels.

positions.title: Entrepreneur in residence  with startup scholarship
positions.description:
Entrepreneur-in-Residence supported by the German Federal Government Founder’s Fellowship, incubated within the Department of Media Technology at Technische Universität München.

Conceived and built an augmented reality hardware platform, including end-to-end prototyping and core machine-vision algorithms.

Developed object and hand-tracking systems using depth and RGB sensors to enable interactive, surface-projected interfaces.

Selected by Microsoft as one of a small group of teams incubated for early Kinect-based development, among the first to apply the platform beyond gaming.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description:
Led international, cross-university flagship programs to translate applied research into commercially viable product concepts.

Owned end-to-end lifecycle of innovation projects, including idea conception, business model validation, resourcing, and execution with academic and industry partners.

Drove development of an augmented reality product concept, enabling real-time 3D object rendering from 2D imagery on mobile devices.

Operated at the intersection of research, product strategy, and commercialization within a global R&D organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built core audio and speech processing systems; early ownership of key customer engagements with Nokia, HTC, and BenQ.

schools.degree: Visiting Scholar, Research on the economics of telecommunication and media industry at CITI

schools.school: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)

company.name: T-Mobile
company.description: As the supercharged Un-carrier, T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is powered by an award-winning 5G network that connects more people, in more places, than ever before. With T-Mobile’s unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, the Un-carrier is redefining connectivity and fueling competition while continuing to drive the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Wash., T-Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile.
